The VPS I'm getting through System Freaks is *much* cheaper than my current Green Geeks plan, and even though I'm losing Wordpress access, upload capacity, and a lot of general ease, I'm not getting enough out of it all to justify the massive difference in cost (I'm paying more per month for Green Geeks
